Observation_Narrative: Floorman observed on derrick floor working at 18 meters without secondary safety lanyard tied off to inertia reel while adjusting mud swivel.
High pressure hydrocarbon bypass line V-102 unbolted by maintenance team without isolation certificate and not depressurized before flange separation.
Drilling fluid aerated with 30 ppm H2S gas kick at wellhead. Two contract roustabouts inside cellar zone without personal gas monitors and no EEBA present on escape route.
Hot welding repair work executed on crude tank roof manway without hot-work permit and zero combustible gas test performed prior to striking arc.
Hydraulic crane hoist wire showing 4 broken strands lifting 3.5 ton drill collars. Contractor crane operator bypassed anti-two-block limit switch.
Technician observed grinding heavy casing pipe without protective face shield and ungrounded power cable lying in puddle of wash water.
Condensate storage pit perimeter guardrails missing along 15-meter section near active pump skid with no warning signs posted.
Swabbing line parted under 4200 psi tension dropping sinker bar downhole. Rig floor crew stood clear within designated safe muster perimeter.
Third-party electrician opened 415V motor control cabinet without arc flash PPE and no lock-out tag-out padlocks applied to main feeder.
Rotary table master bushing locking pin worn and failed to engage properly under high torque during drill pipe connection.
